Finite chronal response to one control pulse

A smooth compact-support bump is the proposed channel's temporal point-spread function. It is exactly zero outside ±σq; its width scales with the mission's look-back rate. This is a transfer-function specification, not a solved field response.

Science-fiction premise: the information field follows a continuous future-directed path through a CTC. Its local proper time advances all along the route, even though the chosen Earth-time coordinate can decrease on one segment. Entangled correlations help prepare and compare the field state; they do not carry the message or create that path.

Model limits. The static, spherical Morris–Thorne example is a geometry-to-stress calculation only. The pastward schedule, compact-support echo kernel, scalar feedback law, envelope normalization, and direct carrier mapping are story postulates; they are not a solved, self-consistent chronology-violating metric or quantum field. This panel has no moving-mouth solution, derived kernel, quantum-inequality solver, or neural interface. The negative-energy source is unresolved, and every apparent gain/resolution value depends on the fictional inputs.
